equipmentReferences.label: Haulage reference   ·   Kenworth T880
equipmentReferences.detail: Project flatbed   ·   14.6 m deck   ·   21.8 t payload

equipmentReferences.label: GE LM2500 DLE   ·   60 Hz
equipmentReferences.detail: 22.7 MW net on natural gas at ISO conditions

equipmentReferences.label: Coolant distribution reference
equipmentReferences.detail: Vertiv XDU1350   ·   1,368 kW at 4 K approach

cues.title: GPU SILO
cues.spec: 25 m outer diameter   /   17 m clear bore
cues.say: Twenty-five metres across, the silo encloses a seventeen-metre bore.
cues.caption: 25 m across, the silo encloses a 17 m bore.

cues.title: Concrete shell
cues.spec: 10 lifts × 3.2 m   /   32 m high
cues.say: Ten jumpform lifts take the shell to thirty-two metres. The circular raft is two metres thick.
cues.caption: Ten jumpform lifts take the shell to 32 m. The circular raft is 2 m thick.

cues.title: Liquid containment
cues.spec: 400 mm outer wall   /   duplex stainless hoops
cues.say: Duplex stainless hoop bars carry tension in the outer wall. A bonded liner accommodates the design crack opening of roughly four tenths of a millimetre.
cues.caption: Duplex stainless hoop bars carry tension in the outer wall. A bonded liner accommodates the design crack opening of roughly 0.4 mm.

cues.title: Tandem cage lift
cues.spec: 62 m modelled booms   /   LR 1300.1 SX class
cues.say: The tandem lift uses sixty-two-metre booms. Liebherr’s L R thirteen hundred is a three-hundred-tonne class reference. Capacity depends on radius.
cues.caption: The tandem lift uses 62 m booms. Liebherr’s LR 1300 is a 300 t class reference. Capacity depends on radius.

cues.title: Top guide
cues.spec: Sliding collar   /   4 radial arms
cues.say: Four radial arms restrain the shaft laterally. The collar allows vertical movement.
cues.caption: Four radial arms restrain the shaft laterally. The collar allows vertical movement.

cues.title: Pod receiving
cues.spec: 2 pods per delivery   /   7.16 m cantilever
cues.say: Each four-rack pod spans seven point one six metres. The receiving lane handles two pods per delivery.
cues.caption: Each four-rack pod spans 7.16 m. The receiving lane handles two pods per delivery.

cues.title: Radial store
cues.spec: 8 levels × 8 pods   /   2.77 m tier pitch
cues.say: Eight levels accommodate sixty-four pods and two hundred fifty-six racks.
cues.caption: Eight levels accommodate 64 pods and 256 racks.

cues.title: Heat rejection
cues.spec: 30 × 2 MW thermal   /   10 frames
cues.say: Thirty dry coolers provide sixty megawatts of nominal heat rejection.
cues.caption: Thirty dry coolers provide 60 MW of nominal heat rejection.

cues.title: Fuel supply
cues.spec: Propane for normal generation   /   separate emergency diesel
cues.say: Bulk propane supplies both gas turbines. Diesel has a separate storage and transfer system, reserved for declared emergencies.
cues.caption: Bulk propane supplies both gas turbines. Diesel has a separate storage and transfer system, reserved for declared emergencies.

cues.title: Annular store
cues.spec: 6,524 m³   /   25% propylene glycol
cues.say: The annulus holds over sixty-five hundred cubic metres of glycol solution.
cues.caption: The annulus holds over 6,500 m³ of glycol solution.

cues.title: Generator support
cues.spec: 94.5 t per assumed turbine set   /   independent support ring
cues.say: Each turbine package has an assumed mass of ninety-four and a half tonnes, carried on independent rail girders.
cues.caption: Each turbine package has an assumed mass of 94.5 t, carried on independent rail girders.

cues.title: Emergency generation
cues.spec: 4 × 2.5 MW   /   Cat 3516C class
cues.say: Four diesels cover seven megawatts of priority computing. Cat’s thirty-five sixteen C is a standby reference.
cues.caption: Four diesels cover 7 MW of priority computing. Cat’s 3516C is a standby reference.

cues.title: Propane turbine generators
cues.spec: Design 2 × 25 MW   /   GE LM2500 DLE reference
cues.say: The design assumes two twenty-five-megawatt propane turbines. For comparison, G E’s L M twenty-five hundred D L E delivers twenty-two point seven megawatts net on natural gas at I S O conditions.
cues.caption: The design assumes two 25 MW propane turbines. For comparison, GE’s LM2500 DLE delivers 22.7 MW net on natural gas at ISO conditions.

cues.title: Control room
cues.spec: 3 operator consoles   /   1 receiving lane retained
cues.say: Three operator consoles share the building with the receiving lane.
cues.caption: Three operator consoles share the building with the receiving lane.

cues.title: Steel shaft
cues.spec: Fixed Ø1.16 m   /   24 × M56 base anchors   /   carrier indexes 45°
cues.say: The shaft stays fixed. Its fifty-point-eight-millimetre wall supports a carrier indexing in forty-five-degree steps.
cues.caption: The shaft stays fixed. Its 50.8 mm wall supports a carrier indexing in 45° steps.

cues.title: Four-rack pod
cues.spec: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72   /   195 kW design allowance per rack
cues.say: Four Vera Rubin racks, seventy-two GPUs apiece, have a combined design allowance of seven hundred eighty kilowatts.
cues.caption: Four Vera Rubin racks, 72 GPUs apiece, have a combined design allowance of 780 kW.

cues.title: Dry cooler
cues.spec: 2 MW thermal each   /   26 duty units at rating   /   Güntner V-shape VARIO class
cues.say: The coolers are rated at two megawatts each. Güntner’s V-shape Vario reaches that capacity class.
cues.caption: The coolers are rated at 2 MW each. Güntner’s V-shape VARIO reaches that capacity class.

cues.title: Turbine deck
cues.spec: 4 box girders   /   70.3 kg/s exhaust at 566 °C
cues.say: The exhaust basis per turbine is seventy kilograms per second at five hundred sixty-six degrees Celsius.
cues.caption: The exhaust basis per turbine is 70 kg/s at 566 °C.

cues.title: Normal operating envelope
cues.spec: 50 MW gross   /   4 MW auxiliaries   /   46 MW IT ceiling
cues.say: Four megawatts of auxiliaries leave forty-six for computing. One dispatch runs two hundred thirty-five racks at full power with twenty-one spare. Operators can distribute that load across more racks.
cues.caption: Four megawatts of auxiliaries leave 46 MW for computing. One dispatch runs 235 racks at full power with 21 spare. Operators can distribute that load across more racks.

cues.title: Thermal ride-through
cues.spec: 10 K usable swing   /   76 min modelled at 51.25 MW
cues.say: With circulation available, a ten-kelvin swing in the stratified store gives seventy-six minutes of modelled cooling ride-through at full design heat load.
cues.caption: With circulation available, a 10 K swing in the stratified store gives 76 minutes of modelled cooling ride-through at full design heat load.
